title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Begins
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati has commenced a coaching camp to prepare Indian junior shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Lakshya, Sindhu Face Tough Asian Games Draw; Satwik-Chirag Have Easier Path
indian_angle: The draw for India's top singles players, Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu, at the Asian Games is challenging, while the star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, face a comparatively easier route.
summary: India's leading singles players, Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu, have been handed challenging draws for the individual events at the Asian Games 2026, while the men's doubles duo of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty appear to have a more favorable path.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to the development of future talent across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully concluded its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course, held across the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Men's Team Clinches Asian Games Bronze After Semifinal Defeat to China
indian_angle: The Indian men's badminton team earned a historic bronze medal at the Asian Games, marking a significant achievement for the nation.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team secured a bronze medal at the Asian Games 2026, concluding their campaign after a 1-3 loss to formidable opponents China in the semifinals.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change impacts junior badminton players across India, potentially altering game strategies and development pathways.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has officially implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
